== Summary ==
Original Japanese [[Dejarik Hologameboard (Japanese)|Dejarik Hologameboard]] from [[A New Hope (Japanese)]]. Card-face crop from [https://www.psacard.com/psasetregistry/jp/imagegallery/4722 Japanese A New Hope PSA showcase], PSA certificate 135901788.

Crop rectangle <code>(126, 616, 1296, 2239)</code> after applying the source orientation. Source SHA-256 <code>31a0e651aa977ab1d87b4b9333947650557305aa59cefe63e1072d6ccb83a28f</code>. Lucasfilm Ltd. and Decipher Inc., 1997.
